summary: Raycast ledge climbing: detect, snap to a hang, climb up. Scaffolding for a fuller traversal system.
overview: Detects a ledge ahead, snaps the character to a hang position, and plays a climb-up. It is deliberately the SCAFFOLDING for a traversal system rather than the finished thing: the climb motion is a position lerp along a curve because no animation set exists yet, but every moment an animation system would need to hook is already an event.
useCases: Prototyping traversal before any climb animation exists.
A simple mantle over waist-height geometry in a platformer.
A base to replace the lerp with root motion once animations arrive.

params.tuning: Keep this tight. Anything on these layers counts as climbable, including props you did not intend.
Measured from the FEET, derived from the CharacterController's centre and height rather than the transform pivot — getting that wrong aimed the check a metre high and missed every ledge.
Purely the lerp length. Once a real climb animation exists this should match its length, or the character arrives before or after the animation does.
Shapes the lerp so the climb does not move at a constant speed, which reads as robotic.

gotchas.title: No climb animation is wired in
gotchas.body: Grab and ClimbUp move the character by lerping its position. With only Idle/Walk/Run/Jump built, a character will slide up the wall in its idle pose. That is expected at this stage, not a bug.

gotchas.title: Detection is a raycast, so thin or angled ledges are missed
gotchas.body: It checks straight ahead at a fixed height then down for a surface. A ledge approached at a sharp angle, or one thinner than the check, will not register.
